extVoiceInput.blocked: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in the browser's site settings.
extVoiceInput.title: Voice input
extVoiceInput.sub: Click into any text field in Margince, then press the microphone at its right edge, or Alt+V, and speak. Your words are typed at the cursor, in the app's language. Press it again, Alt+V or Esc to stop.
extVoiceInput.unsupported: This browser has no speech recognition
extVoiceInput.unsupportedBody: Use Chrome, Edge or Safari to dictate.
extVoiceInput.privacy: The browser does the listening: Chrome and Edge send the audio to their speech service to turn it into text. Margince stores nothing.
